findings.scope: State (CA)
findings.title: DHCS Manual of Criteria for Medi-Cal Authorization - Meniscectomy
findings.quote: Surgery to be considered only after evidence of failure of an adequate trial of conservative therapy such as: Protected weight bearing, Quadriceps strengthening exercises, Casts as required, Aspiration of any effusion.
findings.note: State Manual of Criteria 'Meniscectomy' section (signs/symptoms + failed conservative therapy); written around inpatient meniscectomy, not modern arthroscopic 29881 - arguably stale but officially in force. L.A. Care deferral to Medi-Cal criteria inferred; plan site robots/proxy-blocked.

findings.scope: State (CA)
findings.title: DHCS Manual of Criteria for Medi-Cal Authorization - Hip Arthroplasty (Hip Prosthesis)
findings.quote: Severe disabling pain and severe limitation of motion and ambulation due to rheumatoid or osteoarthritis which is not responsive to physical therapy and/or other medical treatment(s).
findings.note: Medi-Cal managed care: DHCS Manual of Criteria governs Medi-Cal authorization; L.A. Care delegation inferred (state criteria hierarchy), plan site itself robots/proxy-blocked. Criteria include indications, documented response to PT/medical treatment, and LOS; manual revision dated 2004 - dated but still the official DHCS manual.

findings.scope: National
findings.title: Oscar Clinical Guideline: Total Knee Arthroplasty (Replacement) (CG069, Ver. 7)
findings.quote: There has been a failure to decrease pain or improve function after at least a 3-month trial of conservative treatment (non-surgical) which has included ALL of the following: i. Active and ongoing participation in physical therapy (documented) or a well-documented home exercise program under the supervision of a physical therapist or physician
findings.note: Full public criteria PDF (indications, 3-month conservative care incl. PT and oral/topical medications, bilateral/revision, level of care). Landing link: hioscar.com/medical/cg069v7.
